source.title: Hard Surface Game Asset Workflow in Blender
source.creator: CG thoughts

analysis.study_scope: Derivation of low-poly asset from high-poly hard-surface mesh, UV unwrapping/packing, PBR texture baking, FBX export, and Unreal Engine validation.

episodes.problem: Diagonal support edges generated by Boolean cuts cause shading distorting during normal baking.
episodes.observed_fact: The instructor isolates the upper mesh, enters Edit Mode in Wireframe view, inserts loop cuts (Ctrl+R), and returns to Object Mode.
episodes.instructor_claim: Diagonal support edges create baking artifacts and must be replaced with perpendicular edges.
episodes.interpretation: Perpendicular cuts stabilize n-gon shading around rounded corners prior to baking.
episodes.reference_evidence: Visible diagonal geometry on Boolean cuts before manual loop insertion.
episodes.modeling_decision: Replace diagonal support lines with orthogonal loop cuts.
episodes.visible_action: Selected top object, entered Wireframe Edit Mode, executed Ctrl+R to add perpendicular edge cuts, exited with Shift+F.
episodes.spoken_reason: Diagonal edges skew normal interpolation across surface bevels.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Edge flow becomes orthogonal to beveled borders, eliminating irregular surface tension.
episodes.failure: Leaving auto-generated diagonal support cuts intact.
episodes.correction: Manually route support loops perpendicular to primary edges.
episodes.transferable_principle: Ensure support loops meet boundary bevels orthogonally to avoid normal distortion.

episodes.problem: N-gons on flat surfaces produce shading artifacts without explicit normal weighting.
episodes.observed_fact: In the Weighted Normal modifier panel, Weight is changed to 100. A Triangulate modifier is added below it with Minimum Vertices set to 5 and Keep Normals checked.
episodes.instructor_claim: Setting Weight to 100 on Weighted Normal and keeping normals on Triangulate prevents bake artifacts on n-gons.
episodes.interpretation: Explicit normal weighting protects flat faces from shading leaks caused by implicit triangulation.
episodes.reference_evidence: Shading irregularities on planar surfaces prior to adjusting modifier parameters.
episodes.modeling_decision: Apply explicit Weighted Normal and constrained Triangulate modifiers to high-poly mesh.
episodes.visible_action: Adjusted Weighted Normal Weight value to 100. Added Triangulate modifier, adjusted Min Verts to 5, checked Keep Normals.
episodes.spoken_reason: High-poly n-gons need stabilized flat normals before baking to low-poly.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Planar shading remains completely flat across complex multi-sided polygons.
episodes.failure: Default Weighted Normal settings (Weight < 100) or missing Triangulate modifier.
episodes.correction: Max out Weight to 100 and triangulate n-gons while preserving custom normals.
episodes.transferable_principle: Lock planar normal direction on hard-surface n-gons using max-weight normal modifiers prior to baking.

episodes.problem: Deriving an efficient low-poly target from a non-destructive high-poly Fluent mesh.
episodes.observed_fact: The instructor unhides the base parametric stack, lowers Fluent model resolution to 6 and bevel segments to 4, freezes geometry, and dissolves support loops using Ctrl+X.
episodes.instructor_claim: Low-poly models are quickly derived by reducing parametric resolution parameters and removing support loops.
episodes.interpretation: Reusing the procedural stack ensures identical silhouette alignment between low and high poly models.
episodes.reference_evidence: Excessive vertex count on base object before resolution reduction.
episodes.modeling_decision: Lower non-destructive bevel/cylinder counts and dissolve internal support loops.
episodes.visible_action: Selected base parametric object, reduced Model Resolution to 6, Bevel Segments to 4, applied modifiers, then dissolved support loops with Ctrl+X.
episodes.spoken_reason: Low-poly geometry only needs to capture silhouette, not smooth bevel curves.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Polygon density decreases substantially while matching the outer bounds of the high-poly mesh.
episodes.failure: Re-modeling low-poly from scratch or keeping unnecessary support edges.
episodes.correction: Reuse high-poly stack, reduce bevel segments, and dissolve non-silhouette loops.
episodes.transferable_principle: Derive low-poly assets directly from high-poly generator stacks by stripping non-silhouette edge loops.

episodes.problem: Curved chamfer faces produce distorted, non-rectilinear UV islands when using default unwrap.
episodes.observed_fact: Checker pattern appears warped along chamfered edges. Instructor selects problem islands, triggers Zen UV pie menu, and executes Quadrify.
episodes.instructor_claim: Quadrify aligns distorted UV islands into clean rectangular strips that follow geometry curvature.
episodes.interpretation: Rectilinear UV strips minimize texture distortion and optimize pixel packing.
episodes.reference_evidence: Warped checkerboard pattern across curved chamfer geometry.
episodes.modeling_decision: Quadrify chamfer UV islands to eliminate texture distortion.
episodes.visible_action: Selected chamfer faces, pressed Alt+U to open Zen UV menu, clicked Quadrify / Relax.
episodes.spoken_reason: Unification of island grid prevents texture stretching across curved transitions.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: UV islands transform into straight rectangular grids; checker pattern aligns evenly along mesh curves.
episodes.failure: Standard UV Unwrap resulting in angled, distorted islands.
episodes.correction: Apply Quadrify operation to equalize face grid coordinates.
episodes.alternatives: Manual vertex snapping in UV Editor.
episodes.transferable_principle: Straighten edge-strip UV islands into rectangular grids to eliminate curvature-induced texture stretching.

episodes.problem: Default UV packing yields low texture space coverage (~48-63%), wasting texture resolution.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor opens UVPackmaster panel, enables Rotation, sets Margin to 5 pixels for 2K texture, sets Heuristic Search to 5s, and runs Pack.
episodes.instructor_claim: Advanced packing with heuristic island rotation raises coverage to 80%.
episodes.interpretation: Algorithmic rotation and tight padding maximize texel density within normalized 0-1 UV space.
episodes.reference_evidence: Packing statistics overlay showing 0.48 / 0.63 coverage before heuristic packing.
episodes.modeling_decision: Use heuristic automated packing with rotation enabled.
episodes.visible_action: Configured UVPackmaster options (Rotation Enable, 5px Margin, 5s Search), clicked Pack.
episodes.spoken_reason: Higher UV space utilization directly improves effective texture resolution.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: UV islands rearrange tightly across the 0-1 texture map; packed island coverage metric reaches 0.80.
episodes.failure: Standard Blender Pack Islands without rotation search.
episodes.correction: Enable island rotation and heuristic search during UV packing.
episodes.transferable_principle: Utilize rotational heuristic algorithms during UV packing to maximize texel density.

episodes.problem: Baking normal maps without a cage or with improper extrusion causes ray-miss artifacts along sharp edges.
episodes.observed_fact: In Fluent Materializer panel, instructor selects High then Low poly mesh, enables 'Bake High Poly to Low Poly', checks 'Cage', leaves 'Cage Object' empty, and sets Extrusion to 0.01.
episodes.instructor_claim: Enabling Cage with an empty object field forces Blender to use an inflated low-poly mesh as its bake cage.
episodes.interpretation: An implicit inflated low-poly cage prevents ray intersection errors on sharp outer corners.
episodes.reference_evidence: Bake setup panel displaying Cage and Extrusion controls.
episodes.modeling_decision: Configure implicit low-poly cage bake with positive extrusion distance.
episodes.visible_action: Selected High then Low poly objects, opened N-panel Fluent Shader tab, enabled Cage, cleared Cage Object field, entered 0.01 Extrusion.
episodes.spoken_reason: An inflated cage ensures projection rays encompass all high-poly bevel details.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Baked normal map smoothly transfers high-poly bevel information onto low-poly hard edges without edge clipping.
episodes.failure: Baking without cage projection or leaving low-poly object missing a material.
episodes.correction: Assign a material to low-poly, enable Cage option, and apply a small Extrusion offset.
episodes.alternatives: Create an explicit duplicate mesh scaled along normals as a custom cage object.
episodes.transferable_principle: Use an inflated cage projection during high-to-low normal baking to capture edge bevels cleanly.

episodes.problem: Engine normal Y-channel mismatch (OpenGL vs DirectX) and exporting unwanted scene objects.
episodes.observed_fact: Instructor switches Shader Editor Normal map input node to 'low_2048_NormalDirectX', opens Export FBX window, checks 'Selected Objects', and checks 'Apply Modifiers'.
episodes.instructor_claim: Unreal Engine requires DirectX normal maps and applying modifiers during export.
episodes.interpretation: Target engine requirements mandate specific normal space orientation and evaluated mesh topology.
episodes.reference_evidence: Shader Editor node tree showing DirectX vs standard Normal map nodes.
episodes.modeling_decision: Plug DirectX normal map into material node and restrict FBX export to selected object with modifiers applied.
episodes.visible_action: Swapped normal texture node to DirectX variant, navigated File > Export > FBX, checked 'Selected Objects' and 'Apply Modifiers'.
episodes.spoken_reason: Unreal Engine reads inverted green channel normal maps (DirectX) and requires evaluated static geometry.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Exported FBX contains evaluated triangulated low-poly mesh with engine-compliant normal orientation.
episodes.failure: Exporting entire scene unconstrained or exporting OpenGL normal maps to Unreal Engine.
episodes.correction: Select target object, check 'Selected Objects' in FBX exporter, and supply DirectX normal map.
episodes.alternatives: Invert Green channel directly inside Unreal Engine material editor.
episodes.transferable_principle: Align normal map channel orientation and restrict FBX output to evaluated selected geometry before engine import.

limitations: High-poly modeling stage relies on third-party commercial add-on (Fluent).
UV optimization demonstrates commercial add-ons (Zen UV, UVPackmaster).
Unreal Engine import error message was not fully diagnosed by the instructor.
